title: Camera service timeout during vehicle wakeup
description: CameraService sometimes fails to initialize after vehicle wakeup. CAN communication may be lost during startup.
root_cause: Race condition during camera initialization.
solution: Updated CameraService initialization sequence in software version 4.2.3.

title: Camera unavailable after ignition cycle
description: Camera becomes unavailable after an ignition cycle. Camera service reports a timeout.
root_cause: Incorrect initialization timeout configuration.
solution: Increased initialization timeout and released software version 4.3.0.

title: CAN communication lost after ECU restart
description: CAN communication is lost after an ECU restart. Gateway stops receiving messages.
root_cause: CAN gateway initialization failure.
solution: Updated gateway software and corrected startup sequence.

title: Brake signal delayed after network wakeup
description: Brake status reaches the application several hundred milliseconds late after network wakeup.
root_cause: Message scheduling priority was too low during network recovery.
solution: Adjusted CAN message priority and startup scheduling.

title: Brake ECU diagnostic response timeout
description: Diagnostic requests to the brake ECU occasionally time out during automated testing.
root_cause: Diagnostic session timeout was shorter than ECU response time under load.
solution: Increased diagnostic timeout and optimized ECU startup processing.

title: Lane camera calibration data missing
description: ADAS camera starts successfully but calibration data is unavailable after software update.
root_cause: Calibration package was not included in the deployment artifact.
solution: Added calibration package validation to the release pipeline.

title: Lane detection stops after processor restart
description: Lane detection stops responding after the perception processor is restarted.
root_cause: Perception service did not reconnect to the camera stream.
solution: Added stream reconnect handling to the perception service.

title: Lidar sensor initialization failure
description: Lidar sensor remains in initialization state after a cold boot.
root_cause: Sensor readiness event was consumed before the service subscribed.
solution: Changed event subscription ordering during startup.

title: Lidar data stream interrupted
description: Lidar point cloud stream stops intermittently during long-duration testing.
root_cause: Buffer exhaustion in the sensor data pipeline.
solution: Increased buffer capacity and added backpressure handling.

title: Radar heartbeat missing after resume
description: Radar heartbeat messages are missing for several seconds after system resume.
root_cause: Radar driver did not restore periodic timer after suspend.
solution: Restarted heartbeat timer during resume handling.

title: Radar object list contains stale entries
description: Old radar objects remain visible after the sensor reports an empty scene.
root_cause: Object cache was not cleared when the sensor frame was empty.
solution: Clear object cache on empty sensor frames.

title: Infotainment display black after boot
description: Display remains black although the infotainment process is running.
root_cause: Display compositor started before graphics driver initialization completed.
solution: Added dependency ordering between graphics driver and compositor.

title: Touch input unavailable after resume
description: Touchscreen becomes unresponsive after the vehicle resumes from low power mode.
root_cause: Input device was not re-registered after resume.
solution: Added input device re-registration during resume.

title: GPS position unavailable at startup
description: GPS service does not provide a valid position during the first minutes after startup.
root_cause: Receiver configuration was applied before hardware was ready.
solution: Deferred receiver configuration until hardware readiness.

title: GPS time synchronization intermittent
description: System time is not synchronized consistently from GPS during repeated startup tests.
root_cause: Time synchronization request was sent before a valid satellite fix.
solution: Retry synchronization after valid position acquisition.

title: Battery state of charge update delayed
description: Battery state of charge remains unchanged for several seconds after ignition.
root_cause: Battery status polling interval was incorrectly configured.
solution: Reduced polling interval and corrected configuration.

title: Battery voltage reading unavailable
description: Voltage signal is unavailable during automated wakeup tests.
root_cause: Signal subscription was not restored after network sleep.
solution: Restore signal subscriptions during network wakeup.

title: Cooling fan command ignored
description: Cooling fan does not respond to a valid command under high temperature conditions.
root_cause: Fan controller rejected commands during an incorrect state transition.
solution: Corrected fan controller state machine.

title: Temperature sensor value freezes
description: Temperature value remains constant during dynamic temperature testing.
root_cause: Sensor polling thread was blocked by diagnostic processing.
solution: Separated sensor polling from diagnostic processing.

title: Door status not updated after unlock
description: Door control status remains locked although the vehicle reports a successful unlock.
root_cause: Status event was published before the body controller completed the transition.
solution: Publish door status after controller state confirmation.

title: Door ECU communication lost
description: Door controller intermittently disappears from the vehicle network.
root_cause: ECU entered sleep mode before the network manager completed synchronization.
solution: Corrected sleep coordination between ECU and network manager.

title: Exterior light command delayed
description: Exterior light command is applied with a noticeable delay during automated tests.
root_cause: Command queue contention during vehicle state transition.
solution: Prioritized lighting commands during state transitions.

title: High beam status inconsistent
description: High beam status occasionally differs between the switch state and application state.
root_cause: Duplicate state updates arrived out of order.
solution: Added sequence validation for lighting state events.

title: HVAC controller unavailable after wakeup
description: HVAC controller does not respond to commands immediately after wakeup.
root_cause: Controller communication channel was initialized before the network became available.
solution: Delayed HVAC channel initialization until network readiness.

title: Cabin temperature target not retained
description: Configured cabin temperature is lost after a power cycle.
root_cause: Target temperature was stored only in volatile memory.
solution: Persist target temperature in non-volatile configuration.

title: Audio service fails to start
description: Audio service fails during cold boot and no media output is available.
root_cause: Audio device initialization dependency was missing.
solution: Added explicit dependency on the audio hardware service.

title: Audio stream stops after Bluetooth reconnect
description: Audio playback stops after a Bluetooth device disconnects and reconnects.
root_cause: Audio session was not recreated after transport reconnect.
solution: Recreate audio session after Bluetooth reconnection.

title: Bluetooth pairing timeout
description: Bluetooth pairing frequently times out when initiated immediately after startup.
root_cause: Bluetooth stack was still loading required profiles.
solution: Queue pairing requests until Bluetooth stack initialization completes.

title: Bluetooth device disappears after sleep
description: Previously paired device is missing after vehicle sleep and wakeup.
root_cause: Pairing database was not reloaded after sleep.
solution: Reload pairing database during Bluetooth service resume.

title: USB device not detected
description: USB storage device is not detected when connected during startup.
root_cause: USB enumeration started before the storage controller was ready.
solution: Retry enumeration after controller readiness.

title: USB file transfer fails intermittently
description: Large file transfers fail intermittently during endurance tests.
root_cause: Transfer buffer timeout was too aggressive.
solution: Increased transfer timeout and improved retry handling.

title: Secure token validation failure
description: Secure token validation fails after a system time adjustment.
root_cause: Token validity calculation used stale system time.
solution: Refresh trusted time before token validation.

title: Certificate renewal job not triggered
description: Certificate renewal does not start when the configured threshold is reached.
root_cause: Scheduler used local time instead of UTC.
solution: Normalize certificate scheduler timestamps to UTC.

title: OTA download pauses unexpectedly
description: Software update download pauses during network transitions.
root_cause: Download client did not resume correctly after connection changes.
solution: Added resumable download handling.

title: OTA package validation fails
description: Downloaded update package fails integrity validation on selected vehicles.
root_cause: Package checksum was calculated with an incorrect encoding.
solution: Corrected checksum calculation and added validation tests.
